top_signals.title: IBM Raises C$2.75 Billion in First Canada Bond Sale Since 2012
top_signals.summary: International Business Machines Corp. sold C$2.75 billion ($1.97 billion) of Canadian corporate bonds Monday, building on a record year of issuance in the currency by foreign firms.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
